verdict.rationale: Daily documents server-side recording control ('trigger recordings... from your server'), cloud recording, and server-side 'recordings complete' events. Delivery to the developer's own storage is shown only by a fragment saying individual media tracks are 'stored in your own bucket'. It is not shown for composited cloud recordings, and the bucket setup is not documented. missing for 10: evidence that composited/standard cloud recordings can be delivered to a customer bucket, documentation of bucket configuration (provider, credentials, permissions), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can record a session server-side and receive the files in my own storage bucket
